SETUP_CODE.description: **How you claim the blog.** Twelve characters or more that you make up and keep to yourself. When the deploy finishes, open your blog's address with `/setup` on the end and type it. Shorter than twelve, it is ignored.

BLOBS.description: The R2 bucket for pictures, uploads and backups. Keep `quireink-blobs` unless this account already has a bucket by that name. The Update Quire Ink workflow keeps whatever name you choose; only an upgrade by hand with git has to put a changed one back ([upgrading](https://github.com/joiha-steven/quireink/blob/main/docs/self-host-cloudflare.md#upgrading)).

BLOG.description: The blog itself, a Durable Object with its own SQLite database. Nothing to choose. Needs **Workers Paid** ($5/month per account): on the Free plan the blog stops at 100,000 requests a day and has 10 ms of CPU a request ([why](https://github.com/joiha-steven/quireink/blob/main/docs/self-host-cloudflare.md)).
